bio.uz: Backend yozaman, unga AI ulayman va o'rganganlarimni shu yerda yozib boraman.
bio.en: I build backends, wire AI into them, and write down what I learn along the way.

about.uz: Qarshida yashayman. Django, DRF va FastAPI'da backend yozaman, loyihalarga Claude API va MCP orqali AI ulayman. MacWin Education'da Python va AI Engineering bo'yicha mentorman. Bo'sh vaqtimda o'z mahsulotlarimni quraman: Tester va Acadium.
about.en: I live in Qarshi, Uzbekistan. I write backends in Django, DRF and FastAPI and wire AI into products through the Claude API and MCP. I mentor at MacWin Education, teaching Python and AI engineering. The rest of the time I build my own products: Tester and Acadium.

role.uz: Python backend dasturchi va AI muhandis

achievements.en: 3rd place at the AI Hackathon (Karshi stage) together with his students

achievements.uz: Onlayn va oflayn formatda 100 dan ortiq dars o‘tgan
achievements.en: Has taught 100+ lessons, online and offline

achievements.uz: MacWin Education'da Python bo‘yicha 100 ga yaqin o‘quvchiga dars beradi
achievements.en: Teaches Python to nearly 100 students at MacWin Education
